changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The erasure of a person ends their personal space with its configuration trail (KR-06, #5094). The append-only trigger lets a suspended personal space's rows go; a team workspace's rows still go only after the retention window.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.config_audit_event_block_mutation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN -- The erasure of a person ends their personal space, and its trail with it: the space had one -- member, so the trail is that person's alone. The erasure suspends the space first. -- Schema-qualified: the trigger runs as the caller, so a session's temporary table must not -- stand in for the workspace and unlock a team's trail. IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace w WHERE w.id = OLD.workspace_id AND w.kind = 'PERSONAL' AND w.status = 'SUSPENDED') THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; -- Retention is the other sanctioned delete (ConfigAuditRetentionJob, 365 days). -- Keeping the window here rather than blocking DELETE outright is what lets this -- table stay unpartitioned while still honouring storage limitation (GDPR Art. -- 5(1)(e)). Inside the window the row is untouchable. IF OLD.occurred_at >= now() - interval '365 days' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'config_audit_event is append-only: DELETE is only permitted past the 365-day retention window'; END IF; RETURN OLD; END IF; -- Permit ONLY erasure, per column: each redactable column may stay or go to NULL. Per-column -- (not all-at-once) so an FK's ON DELETE SET NULL, which touches one column, does not trip -- this. Comparing to_jsonb(NEW) minus the redactable keys covers future columns with no edit here.
IF (NEW.actor_account_id IS NULL OR NEW.actor_account_id = OLD.actor_account_id) AND (NEW.acting_account_id IS NULL OR NEW.acting_account_id = OLD.acting_account_id) AND (NEW.old_value IS NULL OR NEW.old_value = OLD.old_value) AND (NEW.new_value IS NULL OR NEW.new_value = OLD.new_value) AND (NEW.mcp_client_grant_id IS NULL OR NEW.mcp_client_grant_id = OLD.mcp_client_grant_id) AND (NEW.entity_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.entity_id OR (OLD.entity_type = 'WORKSPACE_ROLE' AND NEW.entity_id = 'ERASED')) AND (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'entity_id' - 'actor_account_id' - 'acting_account_id' - 'old_value' - 'new_value' - 'mcp_client_grant_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'entity_id' - 'actor_account_id' - 'acting_account_id' - 'old_value' - 'new_value' - 'mcp_client_grant_id') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; RAISE EXCEPTION 'config_audit_event is append-only: only erasure (setting actor refs / snapshots to NULL, or erasing a membership subject) is permitted'; END; $$;

changeSet.comment: The erasure of a person purges their suspended personal space with the cleanup owners of a team purge, so the approved workspace sweep admits it too.
